item.title: New Guns N’ Roses PV and Key Visual Released for Gundam Hathaway Film
item.description: A new Guns N’ Roses–featured promotional video and key visual have been released for Mobile Suit Gundam Hathaway: The Sorcery of Nymph Circe ahead of its global rollout.

item.title: Hypnosis Mic Breaks New Ground With Interactive Division Rap Battle Movie
item.description: Hypnosis Mic: Division Rap Battle Interactive Movie, an innovative anime film featuring live audience voting, branching story paths, multiple endings and unlockable in-app achievements.

item.title: Inside Anime’s Love Stories: Hana-Kimi, Hell’s Paradise & You and I Are Polar Opposites
item.description: Join us as we discuss the complexities of love in THREE anime series with the cast, Hana-Kimi, Hell's Paradise and more

item.title: TOKYOPOP Brings Alien Stage: The Art Book to English Readers in Stunning Hardcover Release
item.description: TOKYOPOP will publish Alien Stage: The Art Book in English on March 3. The 320-page hardcover features concept art, creator interviews and a Deluxe Edition with exclusive prints and holographic details.

item.title: Running Girl Phase 2 Debuts Harajuku-Themed MV With BEAMS MANGART and tofubeats
item.description: The global music-anime project Running Girl debuted its second video featuring Michiko, a character inspired by Harajuku's street culture. This phase emphasizes motion and emotion while highlighting the collaboration with BEAMS MANGART's cultural initiatives in fashion and entertainment.

item.title: Kinema Citrus Marks 15th Anniversary With Original Anime Goodbye, Lara, Premiering July 2026
item.description: Kinema Citrus celebrates its 15th anniversary with original anime Goodbye, Lara, premiering July 2026. Episode 1 will receive a U.S. premiere at Anime Central ahead of the global debut.

item.title: The Voices Behind Frieren, Jujutsu Kaisen, and Sentenced to Be a Hero | INTERVIEWS
item.description: Vtuber Krystal Vee interviews voice actors from three major anime series, discussing character development and emotional depth. The conversations highlight the importance of voice performances in engaging global audiences and enhancing storytelling in modern anime.

item.title: Interview: Mangaka Shiten Akiyama on Creating HORIZON
item.description: Mangaka Shiten Akiyama discusses HORIZON, its themes of fiction and reality, and cinematic storytelling. Read the full interview and enter our giveaway.

item.title: Universal Fan Fest Nights to Debut New ‘Sailor Moon’ Anime Experience at Universal Studios Hollywood
item.description: Join the adventure as Sailor Moon makes her U.S. debut in a captivating CG anime short at Universal Fan Fest Nights.

item.title: McDonald’s X KPop Demon Hunters: All You Need To Know
item.description: McDonald’s and Netflix team up for KPop Demon Hunters-inspired meals, exclusive photocards, and fan rewards launching March 31.
